update_md5_6cf7e3bfa667d78095517b09daec1.name: add_forceable_session_sync_helper
update_md5_6cf7e3bfa667d78095517b09daec1.semantics: Add a forceable session rehydration helper before event subscription so missed live deltas can refresh from persisted state.

update_md5_7d93aa4d8f2d10c4efad450572689.name: recover_missed_part_delta
update_md5_7d93aa4d8f2d10c4efad450572689.semantics: When a live text delta arrives before local parts are hydrated, re-sync that session from persisted state instead of dropping the event silently.

update_md5_cc944244830e3f1545e743d613446.name: expose_forceable_session_sync
update_md5_cc944244830e3f1545e743d613446.semantics: Expose the new forceable helper through the existing sync API while preserving the cached no-op behavior for normal callers.

update_md5_d088009c935a7e6506f42c59352e8.name: force_hydrate_session_route
update_md5_d088009c935a7e6506f42c59352e8.semantics: Force a fresh persisted session read when entering a session route so restored conversations render immediately.
